allOf.$comment: Python/C# verify the target is an own initially visible object. Native camera verifies measured bounds and frustum; it does not prove an open envelope.

direcao.$comment: Recursos vêm somente de corpos_serie.json. Origem/hash/linha, fim<=180s, conflitos de ator/fala e grupos de2 são verificados pelos validadores.

interpretacao.$comment: Periodos por ator nao se sobrepoem. Boca tem prioridade sobre a expressao; olhar especifico prevalece sobre olhar automatico. Recursos faciais fixos com origem/SHA/linha.

objetos.$comment: Bindings fixos do catalogo objetos_serie; fontes/hash/linha antesCleanup. Parser verifica IDs unicos, apoios, donos/eventos, tempo anterior ao fim e normaoffset. Props nao prolongam a tomada.

poses.$comment: Initial poses only; Python/C# check own supports, actor conflicts and real source evidence. No animation transition or scene duration is implied. Compatible seated upper-body overlays require sobrePoseSentada and literal candidate whitelist.

transicoesPose.$comment: Exit clips require matching initial pose, actual source evidence, native duration and upright ground before completion; no action warp.

veiculos.$comment: Actual owned car/bus/bike/truck plus captured-relative routes; Python/C# reject actor/vehicle conflicts; native seats/ground/arrival required.

attachmentObjeto.$comment: Norma total do offset deve ser <=0.5m, validada Python/C#.

abracarObjeto.$comment: Python/C# require an own visible shopping bag attached to the same actor without events; native hands and torso must stay near its measured bounds.
